FIELDS.NAME: Parcel Plus Solutions
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Parcel Plus Solutions specializes in providing comprehensive mail and packaging services, catering to both individual and business clients. Our core operations include efficient mail handling, parcel delivery, and logistics management. 

We focus on standard shipping services utilizing reputable carriers such as USPS, FedEx, and UPS to ensure reliability and timely delivery. Our facility is equipped with up-to-date shipping and inventory management software, enhancing accuracy and operational efficiency. 

To further support our customers, we offer limited ancillary services, including basic printing and retail sales of essential shipping supplies, which are closely aligned with our primary mail services. All operations comply fully with local, state, and federal regulations related to shipping and data protection, ensuring a secure and responsible environment.

We emphasize employee training, especially in packaging and shipping procedures, to minimize the risk of accidents and ensure quality service. Our commitment to security includes implementing basic measures such as locks and surveillance cameras, safeguarding both our assets and those of our clients.

By maintaining a clean claims history, we demonstrate effective risk management and financial stability, reinforcing our reliability as a trusted service provider in the mail and packaging industry.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 01/15/2023, a package containing electronics worth $1,500 was damaged during transit due to improper handling by the shipping carrier. The claim for the loss was submitted and is currently under review with the shipping company. On 06/05/2023, an additional incident occurred where a shipment of printed materials valued at $500 was lost in transit; the claim has been accepted, and compensation is pending.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Mon-Fri 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM, Sat 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class II, UL Listed, Vault with Grade 1 Security.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Surveillance cameras and basic security measures in place.
